content.title: IBC Client Update: Expired Client to Osmosis Chain
content.description: Due to an unforeseen relayer issue that resulted in the subject client exceeding the trusting period, the IBC client 07-tendermint-1 used by channel-1 for RIO transfers from Realio to Osmosis is currently in an expired state. If accepted, this proposal will update client 07-tendermint-1 with the data from 07-tendermint-3 which is created newly, so that users may continue to take advantage of both the established channels.

content.title: Decrease SlashFractionDowntime Params to 0.01%
content.description:
## Decrease Slashing params.
 The proposal to lower the **SlashFractionDowntime** parameters , was already under discussion with validators and teams at the start of the realio-network chain launch. Currently the realio chain has **SlashFractionDowntime** : 0.5% and if this proposal is approved it will be reduced to 0.01%.

content.title: IBC Client Update: Expired Client to Cosmoshub Chain
content.description: Due to an unforeseen relayer issue that resulted in the subject client exceeding the trusting period, the IBC client 07-tendermint-2 used by channel-1 for RIO transfers from Realio to Cosmoshub is currently in an expired state. If accepted, this proposal will update client 07-tendermint-2 with the data from 07-tendermint-4 which is created newly, so that users may continue to take advantage of both the established channels.

content.title: IBC Update Client: Update expired client to Cosmoshub
content.description: This proposal will update the expired client on channel-2 between the realionetwork_3301-1 networks and the cosmoshub-4 networks. In turn, this will allow users to transfer funds from Realio to Cosmos and vice versa.

content.title: Realio Mainnet v0.9.0 upgrade: Multistaking
content.description: This is the upgrade proposal of Realio Network with version v0.9.0, which enable multistaking feature. Follow the instructions at https://hackmd.io/@MasterPi-2124/ryMYOkgyA, and the release page: https://github.com/realiotech/realio-network/releases/tag/v0.9.0 to apply the new binary

content.title: Change Minimum Commission Rate to 5%
content.description: As discussed in Realio Community in Discord, the minimum commission rate should be changed to 5% to prevent the centralization of delegations going to the valiadtors with 0% or low commission rates. We encourage the validators to change the commission rate to 5% or above, and respect the decision made. An SDK upgrade to enforce the param would be also planned if this is not successfull.

content.title: Realio v0.9.3 Upgrade: Set MinCommissionRate to 0.05
content.description: This is the upgrade proposal of Realio Network with version v0.9.3, which set the minimum commission rate of all validators to 5%. The upgrade will take place at block height 7526754 which is around 16:00UTC Tuesday, July 2th

content.title: Add LMX as the third bonding token
content.description: We propose incorporating the RWA  (Liquid Mining Fund) into the Realio Network as our third staking token. This addition will diversify our staking options and expand the Realio Network's functionality. It aligns with the previously approved multistaking initiative to include more RWA tokens for staking.

content.title: Protocol Upgrade Proposal – Increase validator profitability via supply cap
content.description:
Current APY approximately 4% with supply cap at 75m
RST supply at 35m with a max of 50m
LMX supply at 2.1m with a max of 100m
As LMX and other tokens are added as staking collateral to the network, RIO validator APY will further decrease
Problem: The Realio Network has significantly grown in popularity and competition among validators for delegations has decreased APY to a point of profitability concerns, especially considering the incoming allocation of rewards that will go to new RST and LMX validators/delegators. RIO block rewards are currently too regressive with a supply cap of 75m, as new blocks will constantly decrease as we reach towards this cap.
Solution: Increase supply cap to 175m via protocol upgrade and end block rewards on non-native chains.  Modify cross-chain bridges to remove reserve wallets, burn balance currently held in reserve wallets, and use mint/burn mechanism secured by multi-sig to fix existing bridge issues and work toward fully decentralizing the bridges.  The new bridge will have a 24hr mint limit of 1.75m RIO.
Benefits:
 - Validator APY will increase, making validators more profitable
 - Attracts new validators to the project
 - Attracts new delegators to the network
 - Does not immediately dilute holders or increase existing supply (new supply will be achieved only via block rewards), the market for RIO can easily absorb increased APY.

content.title: Realio Upgrade: v1.0.1
content.description: This release upgrade the SDK to 50, upgrade the EVM module as well as add in a module for bridging. You can check upgrade detail and instruction at https://hackmd.io/@sdmdrfknjer/ryMYOkgyA.

proposals.title: Onboard Districts Platform
proposals.summary: This proposal requests community approval to onboard the [Districts](https://districts.xyz/) platform, a virtual world mirroring Earth, to Realio Network. Specifically, the proposal requests that the designated deployer address for Districts be added to the contract deployment whitelist. Whitelisting is required for the deployer to launch the project’s smart contracts on Realio Network. To ensure security, the project has already undergone a security audit, which was [announced in early February](https://x.com/districts_xyz/status/1889735351746298200). The final audit report will be published to the repo shortly.

proposals.title: Realio mainnet upgrade: v1.4.0
proposals.summary: This proposal upgrades the Realio Network to v1.4.0 with a Cosmos SDK version bump to v0.50.14. The release introduces improvements from the multi-staking module, including support for ERC-20 tokens as valid staking assets and the ability to remove an existing bonded coin from the staking set via governance. These changes enhance interoperability, increase flexibility for stakers, and strengthen governance control over supported staking assets.

content.title: Onboard Districts ($DSTRX) as a staking token
content.description: This proposal seeks to enable the Districts token ($DSTRX) as an eligible staking token within the Realio staking module. By onboarding $DSTRX, holders will be able to participate in governance decisions and earn $RIO staking rewards, expanding the utility and reinforcing the interconnected value between Districts and the broader Realio ecosystem.

proposals.title: Onboard District token (DSTRX) as a staking coin
proposals.summary: Enable DSTRX to be staked within the Realio staking module, giving holders governance rights and staking rewards.

content.title: Remove $LMX as a Multistaking Token
content.description: Proposal to remove $LMX as a multistaking token on the Realio Network. All existing $LMX delegations will be undelegated, and tokens will be returned to users after the 7-day unbonding period.

proposals.title: Realio mainnet upgrade: v1.5.0
proposals.summary: Upgrade Realio Network to v1.5.0 with cosmos-sdk and evm version bump. Node configs will require an update to be compatible with new evm version. Please refer to https://hackmd.io/rdAjcEFMQAyJIx_jHh8TdQ for more details.

proposals.summary: Update consensus params to limit block gas on mainnet

proposals.title: Realio mainnet upgrade: v1.6.0
proposals.summary: Realio Network has been upgraded to v1.6.0, introducing new features including fee sponsorship for EVM transactions and the feegrant precompile. Users can now interact with the feegrant module directly through MetaMask.

proposals.title: Whitelist Freehold Token Studio Contract
proposals.summary: This governance proposal adds the Freehold Token Studio contract as an approved deployer on the network. This enables the upcoming Token Studio product to create and manage tokenized assets in a secure and compliant manner. It also activates the fee sponsor feature for sending EVM transactions.

proposals.title: Update Freehold Token Studio Contract Following Nethermind Security Audit
proposals.summary: This governance proposal updates the Freehold Token Studio deployer contract following the completed Nethermind security audit. The proposal maintains the contract as an approved deployer on the network, enabling the upcoming Token Studio product to securely create and manage tokenized assets in a compliant manner.

proposals.title: Update Freehold Token Factory 1.2
proposals.summary: This governance proposal updates the Freehold Token Studio deployer contract. The proposal maintains the contract as an approved deployer on the network.

proposals.title: Whitelist deploy contract on mainnet
proposals.summary: The proposal maintains the contract as an approved deployer on the network.

proposals.title: Realio mainnet upgrade: v1.7.0
proposals.summary: This proposal upgrades Realio Network to v1.7.0, including an EVM security fix and a correction to query all proposals.
